# ANSYS Mechanical Automation: Checking Units

One of the most tedious parts of automation in ANSYS is unit inconsistency. Rather than having to double check everything, I usually just use the below script as a mechanical snippet (the code is run every solve).

In a case where the same script is used across multiple projects, consider placing a unit checker at the top of your code.
```python
# Accepted units: "m", "cm", "mm", or "um"
unit = "mm"

unitSystems = {
    "m": MechanicalUnitSystem.StandardMKS,
    "cm": MechanicalUnitSystem.StandardCGS,
    "mm": MechanicalUnitSystem.StandardNMM,
    "um": MechanicalUnitSystem.StandardUMKS
}

ExtAPI.Application.ActiveUnitSystem = unitSystems[unit]

print("Active unit system:", unit)
```
